name: For The Young Readers
description: Short, simple words for new readers.

medium: The cat sat on my lunch.
I can hop like a frog.
My sock has a hole in it.
A bug is on the rug.
I see a fish in the dish.
The pig can jump so high.
My kite is stuck in a tree.
The duck said hello to me.
I lost my shoe at the zoo.
We ran to the big red barn.
The fox took a long nap.
The bee buzzed by my nose.
hard: The little green frog sat on a log and sang to the moon.
My big brown dog likes to dig holes in the mud.
I saw a mouse run under the house with a piece of cheese.
The baby bird fell asleep in my left shoe.
We made a fort out of pillows and nobody could get in.
The silly old goat ate the buttons off my coat.
I put my boots on the wrong feet and walked like a duck.
A snail came to tea and took all day to get here.
The sun went to bed, so the stars came out to play.
My cat thinks the box is better than the toy.
